notes.title: The Inn-Sanity is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Our game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688570/The_InnSanity/]The Inn-Sanity,[/url] is out! Now it's in Early Access and on sale!

The Inn-Sanity is a story-driven horror. It begins with the mass transformation of people into monsters. You and several others find yourself locked in a hotel and must find a way to get out. With each passing day influence of the hotel will grow.

Here's what lies in the hotel:
• Various memorable monsters. You'll have to run from some and hide from others. Some of them you'll have to persuade.
• Intense conversations with paranoid survivors and insane creatures. In order to survive, you need to find the right approach to each dialogue.
• Several endings. Your decisions will determine the future for yourself and other guests of the hotel.
• The hotel is changing. The environment is getting darker, stranger and more hostile with each passing day.

Welcome to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688570/The_InnSanity/]hotel[/url]!

notes.title: Hotfix 05/24/22
notes.content:
Hey! 
After the last update, we started receiving reports that some players are unable to log into the game due to missing buttons in the main menu. It turns out that during the update, the fonts that support the Chinese language were corrupted. Without them, messages in Chinese were not displayed, which means that the buttons were not displayed either. We've fixed this issue and Chinese players should now see all of the UI again. 

Sincerely, 
Team SteppeHare

notes.title: Fix of the launch issue
notes.content:
Hello! We know that some of our players have been experiencing problems launching the game. Unfortunately, we could not determine its source until we collected enough information.

Now we have managed to find out the most common source of the problem. It turned out that some modern processors stopped supporting older versions of the Unreal Engine on which our game were based on. We ported Mists of Aiden to the new version of Unreal Engine, which should fix most of the launch issues.

We hope this will help you!

Sincerely,
Team Steppe Hare

notes.title: Our new game Prognostic is available in Early Access
notes.content:
Our team has been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671280/Prognostic/]Prognostic [/url]for over a year and now you can finally play it. In this mystical horror, you will be able to solve crimes through communication with spirits.

notes.title: Hotfix 01/26/2021
notes.content:
Hi! 

One of the players recently have found a new bug and told us about it. It turns out that you could walk through the walls of one of the bedrooms on the second floor. 
We've added a small hotfix to solve this issue and now it's gone. Please, email us if you have any problems with a game and we will try to make it better.

notes.title: "Mists of Aiden" and Why We've Changed the Title
notes.content:
Hi!

A couple of days ago, we received an email that made our entire team very anxious. It was letter from Hasbro. They accused us in infringement of their trademark — board-game "BETRAYAL AT HOUSE ON THE HILL". 

This was shock to us. Our games are completely different: we have different plot, different gameplay and even different themes. It is a very difficult for somebody to mix up our games, especially considering their have a different format and different titles. 

Unfortunately, we are a very small development team (SteppeHare consists of three people), and we do not have enough finances to prove ourselves through court. 

We want to make sure that you will be able to play our game in the future, and because of that we decided to change its title. This change will not affect gameplay or the ability to play our game through Steam in any way. The change of the title — is the only change in the game. And it seems to us that we've chosen a worthy replacement. 

Thank you for your support! 

Best Regards, 
SteppeHare Studio.

notes.title: Official release and Steam Trading cards!
notes.content:
Hi! We are happy to announce that final vesion of House on the Hill is already here!

Thank you for all your support! Your emails, comments and other feedback helped us to make House on the Hill so much better. For example, many parts of today's update were made based on your suggestions.

That’s not all, though. We've also added Steam Trading Cards, emojis and backgrounds.

[h3]Here's what you will find in today's big update:[/h3]
[list]
[*]  New scenes that will expand the ghostly route. They will allow you to better understand what happened inside the mansion... at least in this version of events.
[*]  New elements and objects in the final part of the game that will form new connections with the rest of the story.
[*]  Steam Trading Cards, emoticons and backgrounds!
[*]  Several improved scenes and visual effects.
[*]  New sounds in the underground areas of the mansion.
[*]  Improvements in the quality of the English text.
[*]  Several new intense moments that will make House on the Hill even more terrifying.
[*]  Bug fixes and many other improvements!
[/list]

Enjoy! And thank you for supporting us all this time!

notes.title: Big Update: Gamepad Support, Performance Upgrade and other changes!
notes.content:
In this update we've decided to focus on your most often suggestions: performance upgrades and changes in control scheme. We've optimized multiple elements of the game and significantly expanded the control options — all of it is to ensure that playing House on the Hill will be as pleasant an experience as possible. Here's what awaits you in this update:

[h3]Performance improvement:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Locations of the game have been divided into smaller segments to make their loading smoother and less noticeable during play-through.
[*] We've added the ability to completely disable Post-Process and Anti-Aliasing in the Settings menu in order to increase performance on slow computers.
[*] Lights, materials and textures have been examined and reworked to increase performance without sacrifices in image quality. This reduced the workload on a video-card and also decreased overall game size from 10.5 GB to 8 GB.
[/list]

[h3]New Control Options:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Let's start with the main thing right away: Now you can play House on the Hill on a gamepad!
[*] Now you can change the key bindings in the Controls section of the Menu. You can freely change both the keyboard and the gamepad controls.
[*] The Default button has been added to the Settings section in case you are not sure about your changes.
[/list]

[h3]Text Quality Improvements:[/h3]
Our new friend, Dan Weatherer, has been helping us a lot with our English version of the game. Because of him many notes and descriptions now sound much more natural than before.


Apart from that, we also worked on many small bugs and issues. Here's just a few of them.

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] There were difficulties in taking a picture of the last door on the second floor. Fixed.
[*] Some street elements overlapped with each other. Fixed.
[*] The appearance of the several items has been fixed: calendar, tablets, powder and others.
[*] A bug where you could see emptiness behind the door on the second floor has been removed.
[*] We've added an additional checkpoint in the final part of the game, right before your choice.
[*] Fixed a bug when a mannequin appeared, his hand could pass through the wall.
[*] Broken plates will no longer teleport into a sad, desolate oblivion of a porcelain afterlife. They will stay on the floor.
[*] In some cases the door of the office on the first floor could stay open during a cutscene. In that case the player was able to see a spawn of the enemy. Fixed.
[*] We also added many other minor improvements and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Meet the actors!
notes.content:
Today we want to tell you about those who worked with us on House on the Hill. We couldn't have completed this game without the help of these excellent voice actors. They allowed us to make our characters feel truly alive, and we are infinitely grateful to them for that opportunity. Please meet the voices of House on the Hill:

[b]English voice actors:[/b]
[b]Accomplice[/b]: Alexander Hanly is the voice actor and main voice of the game. You can reach him at his page castingcall.club/m/blairlex.
[b]Nadine[/b]: Jamie Wade is a voice actress who perfectly complements our story. You can contact her at her page castingcall.club/m/JFOfficial.

[b]Russian voice actors:[/b]
[b]Accomplice[/b]: Yuri Lukin is the main voice of the game and a talented streamer. You can chat with him on the LookinPlay channel (twitch.tv/lookinplay).
[b]Nadine[/b]: Elena Lunina is a skilled voice actress from DeeaFilm studio. More of her work can be found on [url=deeafilm.ru]deeafilm.ru[/url].

notes.title: Patch from 08/15/2020
notes.content:
Hello! This time we've prepared for you a rather big update. It fixes several bugs in the behavior of monsters, errors in the text and improves games optimization:
• Optimization has been improved due to extensive work on textures. We will continue to work on it in the future.
• It was possible to go through one of the doors of the mansion. Fixed.
• Cabinets and drawers were open for interaction even after you moved them. Fixed.
• Strange camera movements after interacting with the cabinet has been fixed.
• In the finale part of the first chapter under certain circumstances you could reach the car without activating the ending. Fixed.
• If you go past the fuse-box, take the fuse and return to it you will be able to hear the previous dialogue. Fixed.
• The monster was unable to climb one of the stairs in the final encounter of the cave. Fixed.
• Now the cave monster moves more smoothly when turning around.
• Now the text on the notes can be read by pressing the E button. This will make it easier to understand the text for those who play at low settings.
• Achievement Layers of meaning is now awarded when you take picture of 10 paintings instead of all of them.
• Several errors in the English text has been fixed.
• A typo in the credits has been corrected. We are sorry, Semyon. Thank you for your help with the game.
• TV sounded from a different points. Fixed.
• One of the attic rooms might not be loaded if you are walking along one of the walls. Fixed.
• Now, when a partner temporarily leaves you in the first chapter, he will not comment on your actions until he returns.

notes.title: Patch from 07/31/2020
notes.content:
Hello! We continue our work on House on the Hill. Today we made some important changes to the settings and fixed a couple of annoying bugs.

• The credits of the voice actors have been fixed.
• We made a small changes to the attack of one of the monsters.
• An effect of the kill by a monster became smoother.
• Collision problems with the knife stand have been fixed.
• Some settings in the game menu were erased during the launch of the game. Fixed.
• It was possible to go up to the attic without a light source. Fixed.
• An option "Standard" were added to the settings.
• You could get stuck in the dining room door. Fixed.
• Fixed a bug where climbing stairs along a wall could cause a lack of loading of the second floor.

The release of the game was incredibly important, exciting, but stressful event. We decided to take a short break from the work to rest and finally get some sleep. There will be no patches for about a week. But don't worry, we'll continue to read your comments and respond to your questions. 

See you later!

notes.title: Patch from 07/30/2020
notes.content:
Hi! We continue to collect your feedback and use them to make House on the Hill better. Here's today's fixes.

• The mistake in the note was corrected (from “lungs” to “brain”).
• Now you can see an option to chose a dialogue language during the first launch of the game.
• There was a serious drop in fps during a short period on the second floor. Fixed.
• Some dialogues didn't had a subtitles. Fixed.
• One of the text fragments didn't have a Russian translation. Fixed.
• An option to skip Credits has been added.
• The effect of sparks from the boiler room has been changed. Now they became more noticeable.
• The doors to the balcony from the final ending are now locked.
• Collision to the trees has been added.
• The charge of the flashlight was seen in the inventory. It's has been removed. The batteries are new, you don't need to change them.
• Climbing behind the table in the living room could get you stuck. Fixed.
• The first seconds of the Prologue now starts more smoothly.
• The candle light in the final ending has been put back in its place.
• A graphic bug related to the printer has been fixed.
• Now you can't go into the fire.
• The sound of the fire has been to one of the final scenes.

notes.title: Patch from 07/29/2020
notes.content:
Hello! We are follow your feedback closely and are very happy with your support. We've put together a list of potential issues that Early Access launch helped us to identify. And the first of them will be fixed today.

• During the first launch of the game, the "Continue" button in the main menu allowed the player to skip the Prologue. Fixed.
• One of the doors didn't have a collision, and it was possible to pass through it. Fixed.
• The pedestals in the hallway displayed unwanted text if you click on them. Fixed.

That's all for today. The new patch will be ready tomorrow.
In the meantime, we will continue to work on the game based on your comments and feedback. [i]Thank you for help![/i]
